newsitem.title: USA: Marshall sees Q4 shr beating estimates.
newsitem.headline: Marshall sees Q4 shr beating estimates.

text.p: Marshall Industries said Wednesday it expects fourth quarter earnings to be between $0.68 and $0.71 per share, beating the First Call consensus estimate of $0.64 per share.
The company also said it anticipates earnings for fiscal 1997 ended May 31 to be between $2.29 and $2.33 versus $2.86 in 1996. The First Call consensus EPS estimate had been $2.26.
Net sales for the fourth quarter of fiscal 1997 rose to $325 million from last year's $305 million, the company said.
The company said it recorded net sales of $1.19 billion for the fiscal year versus $1.17 billion for fiscal 1996.
The company said it plans to release final results for fiscal 1997 in mid-July.
